prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
**Onyx Grappling** looks like a good first place to try if you’re open to Brazilian jiu-jitsu. It’s at **953 Jungermann Road** and offers age-grouped kids’ classes (including ages 4–6 and 7–9), with a focus on confidence, focus, and practical self-defense. Its site lists a **5/5 rating from 14 reviews**. [Onyx Grappling](https://onyxgrappling.com/)

If you’d prefer a broader martial-arts program, **ATA Martial Arts St. Peters** at **6720 Mexico Road** offers kids’ classes and advertises a six-week introductory offer. [ATA Martial Arts](https://www.atastpeters.com/)

I’d visit or try a class before committing, and ask about instructor experience with your child’s age, class size, safety practices, and the full contract and fees.
